edges.notes: Requires KVM (`/dev/kvm`) on supported Linux architectures per Firecracker docs.
Firecracker is a VMM that programs the Linux KVM API on supported hosts per Firecracker documentation.
Used in some Kubernetes-adjacent isolation stacks (e.g., Kata Containers class); cite stack-specific docs per claim.
Different isolation boundary (microVM vs namespaced process); substitutable only in narrow 'strong isolation' framing—avoid over-claiming.
Firecracker guests use virtio block and network devices; virtio is the interface contract, Firecracker is the VMM.
Host datapaths for virtio devices may involve vhost-class mechanisms depending on kernel and configuration.
MicroVM stacks may compose VFIO-class passthrough where supported by platform and VMM configuration (survey-level).
Both are VMM-class stacks with different scope (microVM Firecracker vs general-purpose QEMU); not drop-in substitutes.
